scope: GitHub recursive-tree metadata and existing local manifests; no historical blobs downloaded again; no fits or historical edits.
limitations: GitHub comment timestamps are server-side; execution and readback timestamps are recorded by the execution host, whose clock synchronization is not independently attested.
Commit author/committer timestamps alone do not prove publication time. Unedited GitHub publication comments pin the exact pre-analysis SHA before the recorded execution start.
Git object identities establish byte preservation for the manifest scope. Historical private-file preservation remains based on published hash receipts; private file bytes were unavailable.
assignment_to_preanalysis_line_ending_ch: Only adds labs/decision_functions_post_es_diagnostics_v1/** text eol=lf; existing rules unchanged.
fresh_run_execution_requirements: Bind the new output root and exact 82-world schedule: 246 shared fit identities and 31,488 personal solve identities. Derive terminal expectations from the frozen schedule instead of hard-coded diagnostic counts.
Freeze an explicit CPU/RSS/time budget for the larger workload; do not inherit the diagnostic supervisor's hard-coded 600 CPU seconds and 1 GiB without review.
Keep a cumulative command ledger that retains failed and interrupted work. Never add nested per-fit CPU again to command CPU totals.

Exercise real executor/supervisor boundaries using mocks before freeze: command-launch failure, child nonzero exit, resource stop, supervisor interruption, ordinary completion, and terminal serialization failure.

On supervisor exception or interruption, terminate and wait for its child (and any permitted descendants), preserve an unresolved attempt if completion cannot be certified, and write an unambiguous nonqualifying terminal state.

Use reporting-only recovery that reads retained artifacts and cannot call a solver. No fitting replay or automatic retries after failure; any authorized continuation must be limited to previously unstarted frozen identities.
Make failure_reason incompatible with scientific qualification and require verified inventory/integrity/numerical/scientific status, rather than accepting mere terminal-file existence.
Retain limitations of sampled CPU/RSS and distinguish a sampled enforcement target from an exact process-lifetime resource bound.
